pointOfInterests.name: North Fork Boat Ramp Take Out

detail.description: In his book America's Great River Journeys, Tim Palmer describes the reach from below Sunbeam Dam to Corn Creek as 'a medley of mostly class II and some class III whitewater with captivating views, cottonwood forests, and roads that share the valley and canyon corridors bud intrude little on the overall atmosphere.'
